review:
A 7x7 fruit cluster game where you need six or more to win. Purple wilds land on all reels, and the four corners hold special spots for modifiers.

Chocolate modifiers give instant cash from 2x to 50x, green candies bring a random multiplier for every win, and cannons and rockets add other effects. Those corners give each spin a bit of extra suspense. Up to 10,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
